cast_prompt: Cinematic photoreal 3D rendered character reference sheet on a neutral slate-grey background, 16:9. LEFT side labeled 'RIDER': a lean young dragon rider in their early twenties, weathered tan leather flight harness over a charcoal tunic, fingerless leather gloves, short windblown dark hair, a faded crimson sash knotted at the waist; full body, neutral standing pose, even soft studio lighting. RIGHT side labeled 'DRAGON': a horse-sized bronze-scaled dragon with amber eyes and a distinctive tattered left wingtip, a worn leather riding saddle strapped behind its shoulders; full body in profile. Identical lighting and art style across both subjects, high-detail cinematic CG, no text other than the two labels RIDER and DRAGON.
directive_text:
[MOMENT 1 | the rider mounts the bronze dragon on a cliff ledge at dawn]
- MASTER [WS]: Wide cinematic shot on a windswept cliff ledge at dawn. The lean young rider in the tan leather flight harness, charcoal tunic and crimson sash sets a boot in the stirrup of the bronze-scaled dragon's worn leather saddle. Amber dawn light rakes from screen-left, long shadows across the rock, valley haze far below.
- ANGLE [MCU]: Medium close-up on the rider, jaw set, eyes lifted to the horizon, windblown dark hair, the same tan leather harness and crimson sash catching the same amber dawn light.
- ANGLE [OTS]: Over-the-shoulder from behind the rider, looking past their shoulder at the bronze dragon's amber eye and saddle, the cliff edge and hazy valley beyond.
- ANGLE [INSERT]: Tight insert of the rider's gloved hand gripping the saddle horn, bronze scales and worn leather filling the frame, warm dawn rim light.

[MOMENT 2 | the dragon launches off the cliff into the valley]
- MASTER [ELS]: Extreme long shot, the bronze dragon with the tattered left wingtip drops off the cliff ledge into the dawn-lit valley, wings snapping fully open, the rider low against its neck. Vast hazy canyon space, amber light from screen-left.
- ANGLE [MS]: Medium shot tracking alongside, the rider in the tan harness pressed flat to the bronze dragon's neck, crimson sash streaming, wings beating, same amber dawn light.
- ANGLE [MCU]: Medium close-up on the rider's face during the drop, eyes wide with focus, hair and sash whipping back, the same dawn light and wardrobe.
- ANGLE [OTS]: Over-the-shoulder from behind the rider, the valley floor rushing up as the wings catch the air.

[MOMENT 3 | rider and dragon bank hard through a narrow canyon]
- MASTER [WS]: Wide shot, the bronze dragon banks hard through a narrow red-rock canyon, one wing tipped toward the wall, the rider leaning into the turn. Shafts of amber dawn light cut between the canyon walls.
- ANGLE [MCU]: Medium close-up on the rider mid-bank, body angled with the turn, tan harness and crimson sash, the same warm canyon light and flying dust.
- ANGLE [ECU]: Extreme close-up on the dragon's amber eye and bronze brow scales as it banks, canyon wall reflected in the eye.
- ANGLE [INSERT]: Insert of the tattered left wingtip slicing past the red canyon rock, motion blur, amber light.
